top_signal.title: Anyone need a custom website? (Free)
top_signal.summary: Hey all,    I am currently building a public portfolio and need some websites to showcase.    Instead of building fictional businesses I wanted to reach out if there are owners with established businesses or outdated websites need a new website?    I currently work full time, so projects run asynchronous. If you need a website immediately or urgent then we will not be a fit.    This will be also sort of a collaboration because I am interested in the niche and metrics. E.g. which headlines will work the best, so there will be A / B tests running (that’s at least the plan)    You will have 100% ownership. I am not looking for compensation but rather honest feedback, fair collaboration, access to the metrics and later some recommendations by word of mouth or in form of reviews.    Important to know: I am not going to build a shop or a 100 pages website. This will also not be Wordpress or any other CMS. I am looking for small medium sized businesses who need a website to receive leads in form of calls or email signup / form requests. Typical pages are About us, Services, Contact and the legal pages etc.    Again, I am not selling anything but rather want really to help out small business owners. I worked years in an agency and are still working on websites.    If you think we could be a fit let me know!  If you have any questions please let me know too!   Greetings from Germany        submitted by     /u/quitepattern       [link]       [comments]
